lines: Centre for Global Social Innovation - Faculty of Arts and Social Science

Completion of first-year requirements, including at least 1.0 essay course, satisfied with either two half–year courses or one full–year course, with a mark of at least 60%. Anthropology, Centre for Global Social Innovation, English, Gender, Sexuality, and Women's Studies, Geography and Environment, History, Indigenous Studies, Media, Information and Technoculture, Philosophy, Political Science, Psychology, Social Justice and Peace Studies, Sociology are recommended as first year courses.
1.0 course from: GSI 3512F/G, GSI 3523F/G, GSI 3529F/G, GSI 3530F/G.
1.0 course from: GSI 3521F/G, GSI 3522F/G, GSI 3524F/G, GSI 3531F/G.

1.5 courses from: GSI 3000-4999 level; or up to 1.0 non–GSI course at the 2200 level or higher from Arts and Humanities, Social Science, or Information and Media Studies that engages directly with Cultural Forces of Global Change content, as approved by the Centre for Global Social Innovation.
